item: Terminal panel, Maintenance panel and sources tally in the reader's language (R665)
key_paths: src/tui/locale.py; src/tui/panel.py; src/api/ai.py; src/api/quarantine.py; src/static/app-maintenance.js; src/static/app-sources.js; src/static/locales/*.json
summary: The terminal panel reads the locale JSON from Python in the language the browser reported (read-only GET /api/ai/interface-language), else the terminal locale, else English; Arabic stays English with a note since curses cannot shape it; widths in terminal cells; a failed read keeps the language; R658 untouched. Quarantine routes send method_key/note_key (maintenance.*.v1) that the Maintenance panel says in plain words, falling back to the labelled English. The sources tally names its outcome keys in words. 83 strings x12, non-English AI-drafted.
